title: The Collapsed Stair
text: The way down has fallen in, a jumble of broken steps and dust that has not settled. There is a narrow crack in the rubble for the slender, a rope's drop for the strong, and a long way round through tunnels that smell of something living.

options.label: The one carrying least squeezes through the crack and drops a rope for the rest.

outcomes.text: They make it through. The rope holds, and the rest follow.
They make it through, though they leave some skin on the stone.

options.label: The strongest climbs down the rubble, trusting their grip.

outcomes.text: They reach the bottom with dust in every breath.
The stone gives way under their hand. The arm takes the fall.

options.label: Take the long way round, through the tunnels, and hope whatever lives there is asleep.

outcomes.text: The tunnels are longer and darker, but safe. Still, the smell of something living stays with you.
